Header: Scirtothrips dorsalis (Pala makka), Hemitarsonemus latus (mitava), Aphis gossypii , Myzus persicae (kudiththa), Bemisia tabaci (Sudumassa)

Prevention: Use quality seeds and/or vigorous seedlings.
Seed treatment with insecticides (see yellow direct control).
As the peak thrips population occurs during
August, cultivation needs to be advanced.
Establishment of wind breaks (Barrier crops) like maize, finger millet.
Mulching with straw, Gliricidia , white polythene.
Grow plants under shade (suitable for home garden).
Monitoring: Just after transplanting, especially during dry season, observe field for symptoms.
Silvery sheen and bronze appearance on mature leaves.
Direct Control: At the first appearance of symptoms spray water with high pressure to remove pests.
Use of yellow sticky traps in the field.
Neem seed extract at a rate of 30 – 50g of seed per 1 litre of water.
Restrictions: Avoid drinking, eating and smoking during the spray
Use safety measures i.e. gloves, cloths, gum boots, masks and goggles while handling and spraying the pesticides
II (Moderately hazardous); Toxic to bees and some beneficial insects
